title: Business Office Note on the Netting Amount Moved from a Giving School Nutrition Services Meal Account
content:
**Definition.** The netting amount on a giving School Nutrition Services Meal Account is the giving account's balance less a keep of twenty (20) serving days of one reimbursable lunch at the elementary lunch charge of that student's meal status, with nothing else kept and no deposit held back.

**Balance.** The giving account's balance for the netting is its deposits, voids and transfers in less its purchases, refunds, transfers out and returned deposits, as they stand when the netting is made.

**Order.** First every charge counted for each serving day is added together into the day charge; then the day charge is multiplied by the serving days counted and every amount counted once is added, which gives the keep; then the keep and every deposit held back are subtracted from the giving account's balance. The netting amount is that result, never below nothing, rounded half up to the cent once, at the end; a netting of zero moves nothing.

"That student" is the giving account's own student; the elementary lunch charge of each meal status is the one in the cafeteria price schedule.

## Hypothetical giving accounts

| Giving student's meal status (elementary lunch charge) | Keep of twenty days | Giving balance | Netting amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paid Meal Status (3.10) | 62.00 | 95.40 | 33.40 |
| Paid Meal Status (3.10) | 62.00 | 41.00 | 0.00, nothing moves |
| Reduced-Price Meal Status (0.40) | 8.00 | 30.15 | 22.15 |
